{"predictors": [
  {"name": "Inventory Turnover Ratio", 
   "construction": "Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) divided by average inventory, computed annually. Data from Compustat.", 
   "rationale": "Firms that sell their inventory frequently may be more efficient, indicating good management.", 
   "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure."},
  
  {"name": "Customer Concentration", 
   "construction": "Total revenue from the firm's largest customer divided by total revenue, computed annually. Data from Thomson Reuters.", 
   "rationale": "Firms with high customer concentration may be more risky due to dependence on a single customer.", 
   "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure."},
  
  {"name": "Product Diversification", 
   "construction": "Number of distinct business segments reported in annual 10-K filings. Data from SEC EDGAR.", 
   "rationale": "Firms with greater product diversification may be less risky as they are not dependent on a single product/segment.", 
   "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure."},
  
  {"name": "CEO Compensation Structure", 
   "construction": "Proportion of CEO compensation that is equity-based, computed annually. Data from ExecuComp.", 
   "rationale": "CEOs compensated with more equity may have stronger incentives to maximize shareholder value.", 
   "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure."},
  
  {"name": "Employee Satisfaction", 
   "construction": "Average score from employee reviews on Glassdoor, computed annually.", 
   "rationale": "Employee satisfaction may be a proxy for the firm's intangible assets, like corporate culture.", 
   "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure."},
  
  {"name": "Technology Adoption Index", 
   "construction": "Number of mentions of cutting-edge technologies (e.g., AI, blockchain) in annual 10-K filings. Data from SEC EDGAR.", 
   "rationale": "Firms that adopt new technologies may be more innovative and competitive.", 
   "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure."},
  
  {"name": "Political Contributions", 
   "construction": "Total political contributions made by firm, computed annually. Data from Center for Responsive Politics.", 
   "rationale": "Firms that make large political contributions may be better able to influence policy in their favor.", 
   "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure."},
  
  {"name": "Employee Training Investment", 
   "construction": "Employee training costs as a percentage of total expenses, computed annually. Data from annual 10-K filings.", 
   "rationale": "Investments in employee training may increase productivity and enhance firm value.", 
   "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure."},
  
  {"name": "Labor Cost Efficiency", 
   "construction": "Revenue per employee, computed annually. Data from Compustat.", 
   "rationale": "Firms with higher revenue per employee may be more efficient.", 
   "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure."},
  
  {"name": "Supply Chain Resilience", 
   "construction": "Number of mentions of 'supply chain' and 'risk' in annual 10-K filings. Data from SEC EDGAR.", 
   "rationale": "Firms that frequently discuss supply chain risks may be more focused on managing these risks.", 
   "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure."}
]}
